subtopics.title: What databases and SQL are
subtopics.summary: Explains what relational databases are and what SQL is used for. Covers tables, rows, columns and keys.

subtopics.title: Querying with SELECT
subtopics.summary: Retrieve data from one table using SELECT and FROM. Choose columns, rename them and remove duplicates.

children.title: Filtering with WHERE
children.summary: Keep only the rows that match a condition using comparison and logical operators.

children.title: Sorting and limiting results
children.summary: Order rows with ORDER BY and cap the output with LIMIT.

subtopics.title: Aggregation and grouping
subtopics.summary: Summarize data with COUNT, SUM and AVG. Group rows with GROUP BY and filter groups with HAVING.

children.title: Aggregate functions
children.summary: Compute counts, totals, averages, minimums and maximums over sets of rows.

children.title: GROUP BY and HAVING
children.summary: Split rows into groups and filter the groups after aggregation.

subtopics.title: Joining tables
subtopics.summary: Combine rows from related tables using inner, left and other joins. Understand how keys link tables together.

subtopics.title: Modifying data and schemas
subtopics.summary: Add, change and remove rows with INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE. Create and alter tables with DDL statements.

subtopics.title: Indexes and query performance
subtopics.summary: Learn how indexes speed up queries and how to read a query plan. Spot common causes of slow queries.
